professionalSummary: Experienced frontend engineer with a focus on performance optimization in large React and TypeScript applications. Proven track record of reducing bundle size, improving load times, and ensuring accessibility compliance. Skilled in build tooling, automated performance budgets, and translating performance data into actionable guidance.
experienceHighlights: Rewrote a data‑heavy timeline view using virtualisation to render only visible rows, improving rendering efficiency.
Migrated the front‑end build from webpack to Vite and integrated Lighthouse CI into the pull‑request pipeline, establishing per‑route budgets for script size and largest contentful paint.
Fixed keyboard navigation and screen‑reader labels in a drag‑and‑drop task board following an external WCAG 2.1 AA audit, closing all audit findings.
Split the dashboard route into lazily loaded chunks so that reporting widgets load after the main task list.
Authored an internal guide on interpreting Lighthouse and real‑user monitoring reports and reviewed performance‑sensitive pull requests for two feature squads.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Six‑slide demo deck illustrating code‑splitting for the dashboard route; slides show chunk map, loading order, and a performance impact claim (unverified).
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample establish the candidate’s experience with React/TypeScript performance work, build tooling, accessibility fixes, and guidance on performance data. They do not provide a field‑data or controlled‑lab comparison that names a baseline build and date range for a measured page‑load improvement.
